source_contracts.union_rule: single-source agents must also appear; missing any source is a contract failure

envelope_binding_rule.rule: Fail-closed envelope<->matrix binding, NOT enforceable by the JSON Schema alone (a schema cannot import this matrix fixture): (1) when an envelope's agent_id is registered in agents[], a non-null capability_tier MUST equal that agent's official_capability; (2) an agent_id absent from agents[] MUST NOT declare capability_tier=route; (3) consumers PR-7/PR-9/C8C/N5/N9 MUST block (fail-closed) on any mismatch. Exercised by cross-artifact contract tests (codex+route passes, hermes+route rejected, unknown+route rejected).
